tools.name: check_spot
tools.description: Land status at a point (Crown/public land, park, private, reserve…) with the camping rule that applies, special areas (parks, pass zones, tree farm licences), estimated mobile signal per carrier, active logging, the nearest road and its surface, and where to check fire bans. Hunting details are incl

tools.name: find_spots
tools.description: Ranked camping spots near a point that are remote and still have signal for the carrier. Free: the top 3, with how many more the Camp Map Pass adds. With the pass: up to `limit`. access=rental keeps spots on pavement or under 500 m of unpaved road (most rental agreements exclude unpaved roads).

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: One call that answers "can I camp at this spot this weekend?": land status and the camping rule, signal per carrier, the 3-day forecast with workable days, wildfires within 60 km, road reports within 10 km, and the best remote spots with signal nearby (top 3 free, 5 with a pass), with the important

tools.name: work_week
tools.description: Camp Map Pass only (CA$55 a year or CA$5 a month). Ranks nearby spots by signal for the carrier, open sky for Starlink and flat ground, then adds each spot's 3-day forecast and marks workable days (under 2 mm rain, wind under 35 km/h).

tools.name: hunting_spots
tools.description: Camp Map Pass only (CA$55 a year or CA$5 a month). Access points near 5-10 year old cut blocks and winter ranges, with the hunting unit and trail-camera signal. Seasons and bag limits are not included; the official regulations are the source for those.

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Current conditions and a 3-day outlook (min/max °C, rain mm, wind km/h) from Environment Canada in Canada and the US National Weather Service in the US, MET Norway as a fallback.

tools.name: wildfires
tools.description: Active wildfire hotspots, perimeters and incidents within a radius, nearest first, from CWFIS (Canada) and NIFC (US).

tools.name: road_reports
tools.description: Field reports from map users within a radius in the last 120 days: road fine for a car, rough, 4x4 only, washout, gate open or locked, log hauling, turnaround room, camped here, closed, no-camping sign.

tools.name: camp_map_pass
tools.description: What the Camp Map Pass adds over the free map (offline maps, the full scouting list, work-week picks, the full hunting view, more for AI assistants), its prices (CA$55 a year or CA$5 a month), direct purchase links, and how the user gives the pass to an assistant. Also says whether the current reque

tools.name: start_pass_purchase
tools.description: Begin a Camp Map Pass purchase without leaving the conversation: returns checkout links (CA$55 a year or CA$5 a month, Stripe, no account) tagged with a purchase reference. The user pays in their browser; the reference identifies that payment afterwards.

tools.name: pass_status
tools.description: Checks whether the payment for a purchase reference has completed. Returns pending (with a retry interval) or paid with the pass key, which is sent as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" from then on, plus a link that activates the pass in the user's own map.

tools.name: report_conditions
tools.description: Stores a one-tap field report at a point, the same kind the map's users leave (kinds: road-good, road-rough, road-4x4, washout, gate-open, gate-locked, spot-ok, spot-closed, no-camping, hauling, turnaround, no-turnaround, rig-ok, low-clearance; vehicle: car, awd, 4x4, van, rv, unk). Needs the user's

tools.name: confirm_spot
tools.description: Stores what the user found at a camping spot (outcome: camped, signal_worked, signal_failed, road_as_described, road_worse, closed, no_camping_sign), read by the next scouting-list build. Needs the user's Camp Map Pass key; shares the daily cap of 10 stored reports.

tools.name: trip_feedback
tools.description: Stores the user's answers after a trip planned with plan_trip (its followup token): camped there or not, whether the signal worked (worked, weak, none) and whether the road was as described (as_described, worse, better). Stored beside the forecast that was given. Needs the user's Camp Map Pass key.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: The provinces, territories and states the Camp Map covers, with their bounding boxes, when their data was built and their offline packs.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "pass_status" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
